rules.statement: A court cannot grant relief on an issue not framed at the stage of trial without prejudice to a plea of prescription.
rules.supporting_quote: "It appears to me-therefore that the District Court could not, at the stage of judg�ment, have raised ex mero motu, the issue as to the right of the first plaintiff to the office of kapurala not claimed in the plaint without hearing what the defendants had to urge against the raising of that issue on the ground of prejudice to a plea of prescription."
